Ideas have somewhere to go

That idea stays here. This is the place for philosophy, thoughts about music and mathematics, physics and time, technology, unfinished ideas, and the paths connecting them.

Recovered album writing

Music first, theory close behind

The archived listening notes explore alternative tuning systems, microtonal composition, track ideas and the terminology that grew around the music.

These articles will sit alongside the broader philosophy and science writing, with actual text and experiments visible in the page instead of being hidden behind a list of links.

Archived posts can be recovered and edited as the site grows.
